message.content:
Here’s a classic, well‑balanced ingredient list for a moist, flavorful chocolate cake. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras (like espresso powder or a splash of orange liqueur) to suit your taste.

| Ingredient | Quantity | Notes |
|------------|----------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 2 ½ cups (≈312 g) | Sifted; adds structure. |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (≈75 g) | Use a high‑quality Dutch‑process for richer flavor. |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (≈400 g) | Sweetens and helps with browning. |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ tsp | Leavening agent. |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ tsp | Works with acidic cocoa for extra lift. |
| Salt | 1 tsp | Balances sweetness. |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room temperature for better emulsion. |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (≈240 ml) | Adds moisture; can substitute with buttermilk or a dairy‑free milk. |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (≈120 ml) | Keeps cake tender; can replace with melted butter or coconut oil. |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp | Enhances overall flavor. |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (≈240 ml) | Activates cocoa, creates a silky batter. |
| Optional: Espresso powder | 1 tsp | Intensifies chocolate flavor. |
| Optional: Chocolate chips or chunks | ½ cup (≈85 g) | For extra chocolate pockets. |

**Optional add‑ins for extra richness:**
- ¼ cup melted dark chocolate (70 % cacao) – adds depth.
- 1 tbsp instant coffee – boosts chocolate notes.
- ½ cup sour cream or Greek yogurt – makes the cake extra moist.

**Pro tip:** For a lighter crumb, separate the eggs and beat the whites to stiff peaks before folding them into the batter. Enjoy baking!
